distribution.narrative: Historical reports have attributed Phloeosinus granosus to South China, but the precise locality and supporting specimen evidence remain unresolved. A proposed Guangdong interpretation of 'Lilong' and a separate Liaoning attribution have not been confirmed from reviewed specimens. China occurrence is therefore Questionable.
